plans: Credential-format coverage matrix: enumerate structured ways secrets appear in connector logs (key=value, JSON, URL query, multiline PEM, numeric authentication code, authorization-scheme headers), run each through the central formatter, and repair only demonstrated gaps at the formatter boundary with benign parity checks.

Call-site trace and data-flow plan: follow every log statement that can receive authentication material, classify leaks by whether the call site masks, omits, or delegates to the formatter, then choose between a central masker fix and a narrower call-site fix based on observed exposure and regression risk.

Differential redaction invariants: test mask/unmask round trips for full, partial, quoted, whitespace-padded, truncated, and case-varied secrets, looking for prefixes or suffixes that survive; treat any surviving secret substring as a falsifier and add the smallest normalization that closes it.

Parser-boundary comparison: contrast regex substitution with a structural policy over recognized credential keys, then repair the regex set only for key names and value alphabets that the connector actually emits, checking false positives against innocuous log lines.
